- Residency: OrbitX needs US primary; EU residency request was intended as an option for multi-region customers. If you can confirm US-only is acceptable for the core deployment, that will simplify.

- SLA: 99.9% is our ask for the launch plan; we can be flexible on credit calculation but the recovery SLA window is important.

Attached is a marked-up version of the Order Form where our procurement team added a few billing contacts. We do have an internal procurement deadline: we need to complete legal review by Friday 2/19 to hit their procurement cycle. If you can deliver initial redlines by Wed EOD that would be ideal.
